core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mansour corresponds to the Arabic form منصور and is glossed in this record as “Victorious, triumphant, aided.” The record associates the form with root ن ص ر (n-ṣ-r). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mansour corresponds to the Arabic form منصور (Arabic root ن ص ر (n-ṣ-r); مَنْصُور (Manṣūr)). Its core sense is victorious, triumphant, aided. Mansour is Arabic مَنْصُور (Manṣūr) 'victorious, triumphant, aided', from the root ن ص ر (n-ṣ-r). The source gloss 'Victorious' is consistent. Same name as mansoor, mansur and mansuri.
